# Practical Automation Lab

Practical Automation Lab publishes privacy-conscious business software and browser-local preflight tools.

## Primary products

- PAL Catalog Check for Shopify
  https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/shopify-catalog-check.html
  Read-only Shopify catalog-readiness scanning for product, image, identifier, price and variant issues.

- Product Feed Preflight Auditor
  https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/product-feed-preflight.html
  Browser-local Shopify and Google Merchant CSV preflight for structural errors, identifier gaps, image risks and variant inconsistencies.

- Google Merchant API Migration Preflight
  https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/google-merchant-api-migration-preflight.html
  Browser-local migration scanner for legacy Content API usage, deprecated surfaces, customBatch and Merchant API compatibility.

- HubSpot API Migration Preflight
  https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/hubspot-api-migration-preflight.html
  Browser-local API migration readiness checks for versioning, pipelines, CRM writes and private-app changes.

- EUDR DDS V3 Technical Preflight
  https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/eudr-dds-v3-preflight.html
  Technical validation for EUDR DDS V3 payload preparation, supplier-data structure and GeoJSON readiness.

- EU Battery Passport Readiness Preflight
  https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/eu-battery-passport-preflight.html
  Browser-local completeness checks against European Commission battery-passport guidance.

## Commercial access

For paid access, team licensing, batch validation, recurring monitoring or implementation:
https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/commercial-interest.html

## Privacy

Public preflight tools are designed to process uploaded or pasted business data in the browser where stated. Do not submit passwords, tokens, payment-card data, customer records or other sensitive data through public forms.

https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/privacy.html

# Practical Automation Lab

> Practical Automation Lab builds privacy-conscious commerce and automation utilities.

## Paid commerce-data API

- Product page: https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/merchant-center-catalog-intelligence-api.html
- x402 OpenAPI: https://pal-nano-catalog-audit.onrender.com/openapi.json
- Marketplace OpenAPI: https://pal-nano-catalog-audit.onrender.com/marketplace-openapi.json
- Postman collection: https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/pal-commerce-catalog-intelligence.postman_collection.json
- Live marketplace-upstream status: https://pal-nano-catalog-audit.onrender.com/v1/upstream/status

Core capabilities: Google Merchant Center product-feed audit, prioritized catalog remediation, GTIN/UPC/EAN validation, feed change detection, and x402 v2 declaration validation.

Primary paid operation: POST https://pal-nano-catalog-audit.onrender.com/v1/usdc/catalog-remediation — $1.00 USDC per successful call on Base via x402.

Catalog audit: POST https://pal-nano-catalog-audit.onrender.com/v1/usdc/catalog-audit — $0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402.

The API does not require merchant credentials, Shopify login, customer data, order data, or private keys.
